title: Catalog search also matches a full work UUID and the assignee
outcome: Catalog search also matches a full work UUID and the assignee
acceptance: `work ls --search` with a complete work UUID, in any accepted case, returns that item, and search text matching an item's assignee returns it; behavior tests through the CLI or host path show both alongside existing metadata and note matches, with paging and the exact `total` still correct.
No projection, FTS or schema change, no projection repair, and no regression in the search budget; existing matches stay as they were.

completion.summary: `work ls --search` and MCP search now also find an item by its complete work UUID, in any spelling the parser accepts, and by a substring of its stored assignee, with existing matches kept and paging and the exact total correct. One IN over a UNION ALL keeps an indexed search a seek. No schema, projection or FTS change; six live Central stores ready. Search budget measured: steps rose except on note hits, which got cheaper; worst case 1.5% of the budget on 4000 items; no limit moved. Tests: storage test and CLI parity test. Evaluation c5b13677 passed both criteria. Filed: w-c2d759bdf124.
